The platform provides a [[graphic design]] platform to create visual content for presentations, websites, and other digital products.{{Cite web |date=2014-11-01 |title=ABN Lookup |url=https://abr.business.gov.au/ABN/View?abn=80158929938 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250222160447/https://abr.business.gov.au/ABN/View?abn=80158929938 |archive-date=22 February 2025 |access-date=2025-11-01 |website=abr.business.gov.au |language=en |url-status=live }}{{cite news |author=Perez, Sarah |date=26 August 2013 |title=Canva Launches A Graphic Design Platform Anyone Can Use |url=https://techcrunch.com/2013/08/26/backed-by-3-million-in-funding-canva-launches-a-graphic-design-platform-anyone-can-use/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190902223751/https://techcrunch.com/2013/08/26/backed-by-3-million-in-funding-canva-launches-a-graphic-design-platform-anyone-can-use/ |archive-date=2 September 2019 |work=Tech Crunch'}}{{cite news |author1=Lancet, Yaara |author2=Zukerman, Erez |date=7 January 2014 |title=Canva review: Free tool brings much-needed simplicity to design process |url=http://www.pcworld.com/article/2079100/canva-review-free-tool-brings-much-needed-simplicity-to-design-process.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141221134956/http://www.pcworld.com/article/2079100/canva-review-free-tool-brings-much-needed-simplicity-to-design-process.html |archive-date=21 December 2014 |work=[[PC World]]}}{{cite news |author=Swallow, Erica |date=18 November 2013 |title=Canva Makes Great Design More Accessible |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/ericaswallow/2013/11/18/canva/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180816162211/https://www.forbes.com/sites/ericaswallow/2013/11/18/canva/ |archive-date=16 August 2018 |work=[[Forbes]]}} Its uses include templates for presentations, posters, and social media content, as well as photo and video editing functionality. The platform uses a [[Drag and drop|drag-and-drop interface]] designed for its users without professional design training or experience. Canva operates on a [[freemium]] model and has added features such as print services and video editing tools over time. == History == === 2013–2020 === Canva was founded in [[Perth]], Australia, by [[Melanie Perkins]], [[Cliff Obrecht]] and Cameron Adams on 1 January 2013. One of the company's early investors was [[Susan Wu (entrepreneur)|Susan Wu]], an American entrepreneur.{{Cite web |date=11 March 2018 |title=Susan Wu, tech entrepreneur and start-up adviser |url=https://www.vogue.com.au/gamechangers/technology-and-business/susan-wu-tech-entrepreneur-and-startup-adviser/news-story/d47c71f296936e24192d86b6d3532ed0 |access-date=4 November 2024 The new interface combines Canva's design and productivity tools. New features include a [[Spreadsheet|spreadsheets]] application (Canva Sheets), a [[Generative artificial intelligence|generative AI]] coding assistant (Canva Code), a chatbot, and an updated photo editor that can modify or remove background objects.{{Cite web |last=Weatherbed |first=Jess |date=2025-04-10 |title=Canva is now in the coding and spreadsheet business |url=https://www.theverge.com/news/646682/canva-visual-suite-2-0-ai-spreadsheets-creative-workspace |access-date=2025-10-25 |website=The Verge |language=en-US}} In August 2025, Canva launched a [[Employee stock option|stock]] sale to employees, valuing the company at US$42 billion.{{Cite news |date= |title=Australia's Canva begins share sale at $42 billion valuation |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/australias-canva-begins-share-sale-42-billion-valuation-2025-08-20/ |work=[[Reuters]] |publication-date=20 August 2025}} In December 2025, Canva announced that it had reached 260 million monthly active users and US$3.5 billion in annualized revenue. The company also highlighted growing enterprise adoption, stating that Canva was used by 95% of [[Fortune 500]] companies, and described its AI-powered "Creative Operating System" as its largest product launch to date.{{Cite web |title=A transformative year for Canva: 2025 in review |url=https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-2025-wrap/ |access-date=2026-07-26 |website=Newsroom - Latest Canva news announcements, brand guidelines and media kit. |language=en-US}} === 2026-Present === In April 2026, Canva announced several new products, including Canva Offline, Learn Grid, Print Shop, and an expanded professional design suite. Canva, Inc. is a multinational software company launched in 2013. The platform provides a graphic design platform to create visual content for presentations, websites, and other digital products. Its uses include templates for presentations, posters, and social media content, as well as photo and video editing functionality.
The platform uses a drag-and-drop interface designed for its users without professional design training or experience. Canva operates on a freemium model and has added features such as print services and video editing tools over time.
